tor.text: In Krosa, Chainer completes his initiation with Kamahl and becomes a full dementia summoner able to master the Mirari, and he creates Burke for Laquatus. Braids zombifies Balthor in revenge and sets him against Laquatus, then she, Traybor and Eesha reveal Laquatus's treachery and leave him alone in Krosa.
Laquatus takes control of Balthor and forces him to fight Kamahl, but Balthor begs to be killed and Kamahl does so, then kills Laquatus.

jud.text: Kamahl enters the Krosan forest after Balthor sacrifices himself so he can flee with Jeska, and there Seton guides him and Thriss teaches him druidism. Kirtar and his men attack the forest itself, which leads Pianna to travel to Krosa and order him to withdraw.

Laquatus mind-controls the zombified Balthor into fighting Kamahl, who is forced to strike down his old mentor at Balthor's plea, and Kamahl then strikes down Laquatus with the Mirari-sword. He leaves it in the ground and forsakes the Mirari for a druidic life, but the Mirari pours energy into Krosa, mutating creatures and plants across Otaria.

ons.text: Kamahl has just slain Laquatus with the Mirari sword, causing vegetation to flourish around it, but Braids takes Jeska from Seton's hut and kills Seton, so Kamahl finds the hut burned and his sister missing. He mutates the Krosan centaurs into powerful beasts and forms an army under Stonebrow, and Krosa's mutating power also makes Chester far larger and stronger after Kamahl resuscitates him.

Kamahl leads the Cabal and Krosan alliance against Topos in the Nightmare War, and later meditates in Krosa for a year until Stonebrow revives him with the Soul Reaper, though Krosa itself is all but destroyed.

mbc.text: Krosa appears on this set's cards as a place where Meatsqueak lives.
